  {H : Type} (aspis_coreDigest32Inst : aspis_core.Digest32 H)

            state := t5.state
          })
      | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
        core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
          verifier.Prepared (core.convert.FromSame verifier.Error) residual
    | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
      core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
        verifier.Prepared (core.convert.FromSame verifier.Error) residual

/-- [aspis_r1_tx1_caller::verifier::{aspis_r1_tx1_caller::verifier::Accumulator}::new]:
    Source: 'lib.rs', lines 922:22-922:198
    Visibility: public -/
def verifier.Accumulator.new
  (v : transport.Variant) :
  Result (core.result.Result verifier.Accumulator verifier.Error)
  := do
  let i ← transport.Variant.final_len v
  let r ←
    aspis_core.r0.heap.filled aspis_core.field.QM31.Insts.CoreMarkerCopy i
      aspis_core.field.QM31.ZERO
  let r1 ←
    core.result.Result.map_err
      verifier.Accumulator.new.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnOnceTupleErrorError
      r ()
  let cf ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r1
  match cf with
  | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val =>
    ok (core.result.Result.Ok
      {
        weights := val,
        rhs := aspis_core.field.WideExact.ZERO,
        power := aspis_core.field.QM31.ONE,
        next := 0#usize
      })
  | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
    core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
      verifier.Accumulator (core.convert.FromSame verifier.Error) residual

def verifier.mark
  (obs : Option (verifier.Phase → Result Unit)) (p : verifier.Phase) :
  Result Unit
  := do
  match obs with
  | none => ok ()
  | some f => f p

/-- [aspis_r1_tx1_caller::verifier::tx1]:
    Source: 'lib.rs', lines 937:0-943:1
    Visibility: public -/
def verifier.tx1
  {H : Type} (aspis_coreDigest32Inst : aspis_core.Digest32 H)
  (public1 : pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.r0.Public)
  (public_bytes : Slice Std.U8) (proof : Slice Std.U8) (k : Std.Usize)
  (hash : H) (obs : Option (verifier.Phase → Result Unit)) :
  Result (core.result.Result (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8) verifier.Error)
  := do
  if k > 22#usize
  then ok (core.result.Result.Err verifier.Error.Parse)
  else
    let r ← verifier.View.parse proof
    let cf ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r
    match cf with
    | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue v =>
      verifier.mark obs verifier.Phase.Parsed
      let r1 ←
        r1_semantic.verify_observed aspis_coreDigest32Inst public1 v.semantic
          hash obs
      let r2 ←
        core.result.Result.map_err
          (verifier.tx1.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnOnceTupleErrorError
          aspis_coreDigest32Inst) r1 ()
      let cf1 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r2
      match cf1 with
      | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val =>
        verifier.mark obs verifier.Phase.Semantic
        let r3 ← verifier.Prepared.new aspis_coreDigest32Inst val v hash
        let cf2 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r3
        match cf2 with
        | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val1 =>
          let r4 ← verifier.Accumulator.new v.variant
          let cf3 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r4
          match cf3 with
          | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val2 =>
            let g ← weights.powers 29#usize val1.gamma
            verifier.mark obs verifier.Phase.Prepare
            verifier.tx1_finish aspis_coreDigest32Inst v val1 val2 g
              public_bytes proof k hash obs
          | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
            core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
              (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8) (core.convert.FromSame verifier.Error)
              residual
        | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
          core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
            (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8) (core.convert.FromSame verifier.Error)
            residual
      | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
        core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
          (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8) (core.convert.FromSame verifier.Error)
          residual
    | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
      core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
        (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8) (core.convert.FromSame verifier.Error) residual

end AspisR1PublicPreparation
